summary.text: Martina White is a Republican state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 170 since April 13, 2015 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
A financial advisor by profession, she has served on the House Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: Martina White graduated from Villa Joseph Marie High School in 2006 and earned a B.S. in business administration from Elizabethtown College in 2010.
Her professional experience includes working as a financial advisor.

White took office in April 2015, and in the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Rules Committee; earlier she served on the Appropriations, Transportation and Urban Affairs committees, among others.
